text:
Maria K: quick follow-up from today's rollout review. proto: https://figma.com/file/abc/rollback-flow — focus here is undo affordance + version preview.
Sahil P: looked. overall clean. two UX calls: 1) make undo durable if keyboard focus moves to it (so tabbing doesn't cancel), 2) preview 'play' should be unobtrusive — small icon only, not a whole button.
Devin R: agree on durable undo. implementation idea: start a 6s countdown, but if undo gets focus, pause countdown until blur. fallback: if toast disappears while focused, keep it in DOM but visually hidden.
Anya L: accessibility: announce the toast with aria-live="assertive"? i'd prefer polite unless it's urgent. This is reversible, so aria-live="polite" + role="status" feels right. also ensure the preview play has aria-label="Preview deployment changes".
Lukas M: small perf note — the preview diff generates on demand; ensure we lazy-load assets so timeline scrolling doesn't jank. use IntersectionObserver for the tiny play icon.
Sahil P: mobile: toast slide-up covers bottom controls on small screens. can we make it inset above the bottom nav or use a floating sheet on phones?
Maria K: good call. proposal: desktop = slide-up toast anchored to right; mobile = floating mini-sheet with undo action and tiny timestamp.
Devin R: sample CSS for the slide (quick):
```
.toast--slide { transform: translateY(12px); transition: transform .18s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1), opacity .14s; }
.toast--enter { transform: translateY(0); opacity: 1; }
```
Also will wire focus handling: `toast.onfocus = () => clearTimeout(timer)` and `onblur = () => startTimer(remaining)` so keyboard users don't lose undo.
Anya L: for color contrast: the undo pill (white text on indigo-500) passes at normal size but fails at 12px. opt to use indigo-600 at small sizes or add a 1px stroke. Also ensure focus ring meets 3:1 on high-contrast mode.
Maria K: copy tweak: current toast copy reads "Rolled back v12 — Undo" which assumes immediate completion. let's move to two-step copy: on action start show "Rollback initiated — Undo"; on success after server confirms, show "Rollback complete" and remove undo.
Sahil P: timestamp visibility: show relative time inline only for expanded history rows. for dense rows, expose time to screen readers with `aria-hidden=true` visually and `aria-label` on the row `"v12, rolled back 2 minutes ago"`.
Lukas M: also add a micro-animation when a rollback completes in the history (tiny dot pulse) to draw attention without adding clutter. ensure prefers-reduced-motion is respected.
Devin R: will prototype both the slide and the mobile mini-sheet, add aria-live="polite" role=status, keyboard hold behavior, and lazy load preview assets. will post updates.
rollout-bot: Action created: ROLLBACK-UX-302 — "Undo hold behavior, toast slide + mobile mini-sheet, preview lazy-load, a11y labels" assigned to @Devin R, due in 4 days. :white_check_mark:
Maria K: thanks — i'll update figma and the design task list (UX-rollback-202). will review the prototype once Devin posts.
Anya L: i'll run an a11y smoke test after the prototype. pls add a small test plan: keyboard nav, screen reader readout, color contrast checks.
Sahil P: i'll validate mobile overlay spacing and ensure it doesn't obscure primary CTA.
Maria K: great, circle back in ~72h. :rocket:
